companyDescription: AI Semiconductors + Infrastructure Software · Custom AI XPUs for hyperscalers (Google TPU, Meta, OpenAI Jalapeño) + VMware enterprise software
priceNote: Trading $403.24 (+3.26%), extending the Jul 9 pop after Broadcom reaffirmed Q3 AI chip revenue guidance at $16B and extended its custom-chip deal with Apple through 2031 — the market's clearest guidance-confidence signal since the Jun 3 guide-miss selloff.
summary: Broadcom just reaffirmed (not raised, but held firm on) Q3 AI chip revenue guidance at $16B on Jul 9, 2026, and extended its Apple custom-chip deal through 2031 — the stock popped 3.26% to $403.24 on the reassurance after the Jun 3 guidance-miss selloff. Consensus target (45 analysts) sits ~34% above the prior close, with Jefferies at $550. Q3 FY2026 earnings land Sep 3 — the next hard confirmation point on whether the AI chip business (Google TPU co-design, Meta, OpenAI Jalapeño ramp) is accelerating as promised.

catalysts.name: Q3 FY2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: First full quarterly print since the Jun 3 guidance miss and the Jul 9 reaffirm. Market wants to see the $16B AI chip guide actually delivered, and whether management finally raises the flat full-year $100B AI semis target.

catalysts.name: Apple Custom-Chip Deal Extension
catalysts.description: Extended through 2031 (announced Jul 9, 2026) — a $30B+ multiyear deal to design and produce custom wireless connectivity chips for Apple products, diversifying AVGO's custom-silicon base beyond hyperscaler AI accelerators.

catalysts.name: OpenAI Jalapeño Chip — Initial Deployment
catalysts.description: Custom LLM-inference ASIC unveiled Jun 24, 2026 as part of the multi-year OpenAI-Broadcom accelerator partnership. Initial deployment targeted for H2 2026 — a concrete proof point for the custom-silicon TAM story.

risks: AVGO's own history shows guidance sensitivity, not just beat/miss: the Jun 3, 2026 print beat EPS ($2.44 vs $2.39 est) and revenue, yet the stock still fell ~14-15% because next-quarter AI chip guidance ($16B) came in below the ~$17.2B some analysts wanted
The Jul 9 reaffirm was a hold, not a raise — if Sep 3 guidance disappoints a second time, the multiple (still ~62x P/E) would likely compress hard
SOX-wide 'buyer exhaustion' concern — the Jul 2026 selloff hit Intel, AMD, Micron alongside AVGO, suggesting sector-level re-rating risk, not just company-specific
Hawkish Fed dot-plot shift pressures long-duration AI-capex multiples independent of AVGO execution
Customer concentration — Google, Meta, Apple, and now OpenAI represent an outsized share of custom-silicon revenue; any one program delay moves the stock
VMware/software growth disappointed in the Jun 3 print — the highest-margin segment showing early softness that hasn't been resolved yet

estimateDates.note: Key test: does AI chip revenue actually hit the reaffirmed $16B, and does management finally raise the flat $100B full-year AI semis target

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held 3.50–3.75% for a 4th straight meeting (Jun 17, 2026). Next FOMC Jul 28–29 — CME FedWatch prices ~89% probability of another hold, but the June dot plot raised the median 2026 rate projection, now leaning toward a hike rather than a cut.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Inflation still running above the 2% target; the hawkish dot-plot shift removes a rate-cut tailwind AI/growth names had been pricing in.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: High-multiple AI/semis names like AVGO (~62x P/E) are the most rate-sensitive part of the market — a hawkish surprise compresses long-duration growth multiples faster than it hits earnings, layering on top of the guidance-sensitivity risk already in this name.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — no imminent hike, but the FOMC decision (Jul 28-29) lands before AVGO's Sep 3 earnings, and a hawkish surprise would compound guidance-miss risk in a name that has already proven twitchy on guidance.

catalystSpot.preRunup: AVGO historically runs up 5-10% in the weeks before earnings on AI-cycle optimism, but the Jun 3, 2026 print broke that pattern with a guidance-driven selloff instead. The Jul 9 reaffirm shows the market is now rewarding guidance confidence itself, ahead of the actual Sep 3 print.
catalystSpot.preRunupTiming: 1-2 weeks pre-earnings historically, though muted since the Jun 3 guide miss

postWin.note: Jul 9, 2026: stock rose 3.26% to 4.69% (sources vary intraday) on the AI chip guidance reaffirm + Apple deal extension — a smaller but real positive reaction. The larger comparable is Dec 2024 (FY24 Q4), when AVGO jumped ~15% after-hours on a raised medium-term AI revenue guide.

postLose.note: Jun 3, 2026 (Q2 FY26): stock fell ~13-15% intraday despite an EPS/revenue beat, purely because next-quarter AI chip guidance ($16B) missed the ~$17.2B Street hoped for and the full-year $100B AI target wasn't raised. This is the direct, most recent comparable and the reason for the current guidance-sensitivity risk.

spotSizing.reason: BUY verdict with a dated Sep 3 catalyst and ~34% consensus upside, but the Jun 2026 guidance miss proved this name has real event risk around print day — size at 6% initial, add on a pullback toward $365-380 rather than chasing the post-reaffirm pop.
